Hi Methuselahs,
I have a question on "with an optional press" that occurs on many
combat cards. When do these presses "reset", must they be used in the
following press stage, or at any press stage in the current combat. This
question could be extended to "optional" maneuvers as well.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Algustas <arob...@gladstone.uoregon.edu> writes:

>Hi Methuselahs,
> I have a question on "with an optional press" that occurs on many
>combat cards. When do these presses "reset", must they be used in the
>following press stage, or at any press stage in the current combat. This
>question could be extended to "optional" maneuvers as well.
> Algustas

Optional presses and/or maneuvers gained from combat cards must be
used the same round that the card is played, or be lost.

If a non-combat card (i.e., a reaction like Rat's Warning, or an action
like Bum's Rush) gives a maneuver or press, that maneuver or press may
be used at any point in the combat.
